name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience

whyMatters.en: London-based trio (1966–69) that made feedback, wah, and studio guitar effects a lead vocabulary on Are You Experienced and Electric Ladyland.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦基地三人组（1966–69）：在 Are You Experienced 与 Electric Ladyland 上把反馈、wah 与录音室吉他效果做成主奏语汇。

note.en: Dylan cover rebuilt in the studio.
note.zh: 录音室重建的 Dylan 翻唱。

lyricQuotes: Excuse me while I kiss the sky

shortBio.en: Hendrix / Redding / Mitchell; Purple Haze and Watchtower are the mass poles.
shortBio.zh: Hendrix / Redding / Mitchell；Purple Haze 与 Watchtower 是大众两极。

body.en:
Formed 1966 with Chas Chandler. Debut singles and Are You Experienced set psychedelic blues; Axis and Electric Ladyland expand studio layering. Monterey and Woodstock performances are media documents.

Purple Haze (1967) and All Along the Watchtower (1968) show original riff writing and transformative cover craft. Short timeline; permanent guitar technique export.
body.zh:
1966 年与 Chas Chandler 组建。首批单曲与 Are You Experienced 定下迷幻蓝调；Axis 与 Electric Ladyland 扩展录音室分层。Monterey 与 Woodstock 演出是媒介文献。

Purple Haze（1967）与 All Along the Watchtower（1968）展示原创 riff 与改造性翻唱工艺。时间线短；吉他技术输出永久。

body.en:
The Experience matter because Hendrix treats amp noise, wah, and studio mixing as melodic tools equal to blues licks.

Trio format: Mitchell’s jazz drums, Redding’s solid bass.
body.zh:
Experience 要紧，因为 Hendrix 把音箱噪声、wah 与录音室混音当作与蓝调乐句同等的旋律工具。

三人编制：Mitchell 的爵士鼓、Redding 的稳健贝斯。

body.en:
Iconic interval riff, octave/fuzz colors, Mitchell fills—1967 psychedelic single template.

Technique on display inside pop runtime.
body.zh:
标志音程 riff、八度/fuzz 色彩、Mitchell 加花——1967 迷幻单曲模板。

流行时长内的技术展示。

body.en:
Dylan song rebuilt with layered guitars and dramatic dynamic curve—cover as authorship claim.

Studio craft citation for later rock.
body.zh:
用多层吉他与戏剧动态曲线重建 Dylan 歌曲——翻唱即作者权主张。

后来摇滚的录音室工艺引用。

title.zh: 反馈谱系进入 hard rock/金属

body.en:
Page, metal lead players, and alternative noise guitarists cite the permission to use noise melodically.

DNA is touch + technology, not only speed.
body.zh:
Page、金属主音与 alternative 噪声吉他手引用把噪声当旋律使用的许可。

DNA 是触感+技术，不只是速度。

body.en:
Interview fragments about wanting new sounds match the recorded experiments.

Prefer gear and process detail over vague adjectives.
body.zh:
关于想要新声音的访谈碎片，与录音实验匹配。

宁取设备与过程细节，不取空泛形容词。

note.en: Amp as instrument: feedback enters the melody.
note.zh: 音箱即乐器：feedback 进入旋律。
